description: Objective prompts for evaluating the justfile skill. Each eval sets up a fresh workspace from `fixture.files`, runs `prompt` against an agent, and checks the result against `expectations`. Run once with the skill unavailable (baseline) and once with `.agents/skills/justfile/SKILL.md` loaded (with-skill); the with-skill run must satisfy every expectation and must not regress any expectation the baseline already met.

evals.description: Create a capitalized Justfile for a small uv Python project that has none yet.
evals.prompt: This is a small uv-managed Python project. Create a capitalized `Justfile` (not lowercase `justfile`) with recipes to install dependencies, run the test suite, and lint the code.

evals.description: Adding a tenth non-default recipe to an existing flat, lowercase justfile must cross the grouping threshold.

files.justfile:
set ignore-comments
set script-interpreter := ['bash', '-eu']
set unstable

[default]
_default:
    @just --list

# Installs dependencies
deps:
    npm install

# Runs the test suite
test:
    npm test

# Lints source files
lint:
    npm run lint

# Formats source files and the justfile
format:
    npm run format
    just --fmt

# Builds the project
build:
    npm run build

# Runs the project locally
run:
    npm start

# Removes build artifacts
clean:
    rm -rf dist node_modules/.cache

# Type-checks the project
typecheck:
    npm run typecheck

# Generates documentation
docs:
    npm run docs

evals.prompt: Add a `deploy` recipe to this justfile that runs `./deploy.sh production`.

evals.description: Editing a *.just file that already has an `install` recipe must surface the install-to-deps rename suggestion during the active edit, without a rename-only, unprompted change.

expectations.note: The agent's reply must mention renaming install to deps as a suggestion; it must not silently rename with no mention, and must not rename in a commit/change with no other purpose.

files.tasks.just:
# Installs project dependencies
install:
    npm install

# Runs the test suite
test:
    npm test

evals.prompt: Add a `clean` recipe to tasks.just that removes the dist/ directory.

evals.description: A pnpm project asked for update-reporting and update-applying recipes must get the canonical `outdated`/`upgrade` names, an `outdated` that tolerates the non-zero "updates found" exit and writes nothing, and an `upgrade` that does not mask failures. Seven non-default recipes stays under the grouping threshold.

expectations.note: The skill supplies the names; the prompt deliberately describes intent only.
`pnpm outdated` exits 1 when updates exist, so the recipe needs a `-` line prefix (or `|| true` in a [script] recipe) or it fails spuriously.
A failed upgrade is a real failure and must surface.
pnpm-lock.yaml and packageManager pin pnpm, so npm/yarn commands are wrong.
Seven non-default recipes is under 10, so the file stays flat.

files.pnpm-lock.yaml:
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

evals.prompt: Add recipes to this justfile that show which dependencies have newer versions available, and that apply those updates.

evals.description: Adding both update recipes at once to a uv project with eight non-default recipes takes the count to ten, so grouping must be applied to the whole file in the same edit. `upgrade` must also re-sync the environment rather than leaving a refreshed lockfile behind.

expectations.note: Crossing the threshold groups the pre-existing recipes too, not just the two new ones.
This fixture has no informational group, so both recipes land in `configuration` beside `deps`. Neither may go in `checks`.
`uv lock --upgrade` alone leaves the installed environment stale.

files.justfile:
set ignore-comments
set script-interpreter := ['bash', '-eu']
set unstable

[default]
_default:
    @just --list

# Installs dependencies
deps:
    uv sync

# Runs the test suite
test:
    uv run pytest

# Lints source files
lint:
    uv run ruff check .

# Formats source files and the justfile
format:
    uv run ruff format .
    just --fmt

# Type-checks the project
typecheck:
    uv run mypy .

# Builds the distributable
build:
    uv build

# Removes build artifacts
clean:
    rm -rf .venv __pycache__ dist

# Generates documentation
docs:
    uv run mkdocs build
files.uv.lock:
version = 1
requires-python = ">=3.11"

[[package]]
name = "probe"
version = "0.1.0"
source = { editable = "." }
